Split full plant names into name and authorship

Source: R/prepare.R
WFO.prepare.Rd

WFO.prepare() splits full botanical names that include naming authorities (for example "Acacia nilotica subsp. kraussiana (Benth.) Brenan") into the plant name and its authorship, ready for WFO.match(). It also flags names that probably need checking. WFO.preprepare() splits names around a first and a second infraspecific rank, for names that contain two of them.

Usage

WFO.prepare(
  spec.data = NULL,
  spec.full = "spec.full",
  squish = TRUE,
  spec.name.nonumber = TRUE,
  spec.name.sub = TRUE,
  sub.pattern = c(" sp[.] A", " sp[.] B", " sp[.] C", " sp[.]", " spp[.]", " pl[.]",
    " indet[.]", " ind[.]", " gen[.]", " g[.]", " fam[.]", " nov[.]", " prox[.]",
    " cf[.]", " aff[.]", " s[.]s[.]", " s[.]l[.]", " p[.]p[.]", " p[.] p[.]", "[?]",
    " inc[.]", " stet[.]", "Ca[.]", "nom[.] cons[.]", "nom[.] dub[.]", " nom[.] err[.]",
    " nom[.] illeg[.]", " nom[.] inval[.]", " nom[.] nov[.]", " nom[.] nud[.]",
    " nom[.] obl[.]", " nom[.] prot[.]", " nom[.] rej[.]", " nom[.] supp[.]",
    " sensu auct[.]"),
  genus.2.flag = TRUE,
  species.2.flag = TRUE,
  punctuation.flag = TRUE,
  pointless.flag = TRUE,
  trinomial = c("cultivar.", "f.", "sect.", "subf.", "subg.", "subsp.", "subvar.",
    "var.", "CULTIVAR.", "SECT.", "SUBF.", "SUBG.", "SUBSP.", "SUBVAR.", "VAR."),
  authors.ending.f = c("Aiton f.", "Baker f.", "Bak. f.", "Burm. f.", "Cheng f.",
    "Chrtek f.", "De Marco f.", "Fang f.", "Ferry f.", "Forsyth f.", "Forster f.",
    "Fraser f.", "G.Don f.", "Haller f.", "Hallier f.", "Hook. f.", "Hooker f.",
    "Hsueh f.", "J.Kickx f.", "J. Kickx f.", "Keng f.", "Kickx f.", "Klokov f.",
    "Koster f.", "Liou f.", "L. f.", "Ma f.", "Mikan f.", "Occhioni f.", "Rchb. f.",
    "Schultes f.", "Schult. f.", "Stapf f."),
  verbose = TRUE,
  counter = 1000,
  spec.name.aff.genus = FALSE
)

WFO.preprepare(
  spec.data = NULL,
  spec.full = "spec.full",
  trinomial.first = "subsp.",
  trinomial.second = "var."
)

Arguments

spec.data

A data.frame with a column of full names, or a character vector (or factor) of full names.

spec.full

Name of the column with the full names.

squish

If TRUE, remove repeated white space, and white space at the start and end of names (stringr::str_squish()).

spec.name.nonumber

If TRUE, names that contain numbers are interpreted as genera (only the first word is kept, without trailing digits). A morphospecies code at the end of a name (" sp.1", " sp.1_ECOSUR1", " sp9", " sp. 2") is removed first, so that "Aegiphila sp.1_ECOSUR1" gives Aegiphila (WorldFlora gave "Aegiphila1_ECOSUR").

spec.name.sub

If TRUE, delete sections of names that match sub.pattern.

sub.pattern

Regular expressions of sections to delete, such as " sp[.]" or " cf[.]".

genus.2.flag

Flag names of which the first word has fewer than 3 characters.

species.2.flag

Flag names of which the second word has fewer than 3 characters.

punctuation.flag

Flag names that still contain punctuation marks (other than those of the infraspecific ranks in trinomial).

pointless.flag

Flag names that contain one of the sub.pattern sections written without punctuation (for example "cf" instead of "cf.").

trinomial

Infraspecific ranks; the word after the rank is kept as part of the name.

authors.ending.f

Author abbreviations ending in " f." (filius), which would otherwise be mistaken for the rank "f." (forma).

verbose

If TRUE, report the changes made to names.

counter

Progress is reported every counter distinct names.

spec.name.aff.genus

If TRUE, names with "aff." (affinis, near but not this species, as in "Drypetes aff. amazonica") are reduced to the genus. FALSE (default) removes "aff." with sub.pattern and matches the species, as in WorldFlora. Give the same value to WFO.prepare() and WFO.match(): this function already removes "aff." from the names it returns.

trinomial.first, trinomial.second

First and second infraspecific rank used by WFO.preprepare() to split names.

Value

WFO.prepare(): spec.data (a data.frame) with the added columns spec.name and Authorship (omitted when no authorship was found) and the requested flag columns. Existing columns spec.name and Authorship are renamed with suffix .ORIG.

WFO.preprepare(): spec.data with logical columns first (first rank found), only.second (only the second rank found), also.second (second rank found after the first), and the split sections split.before, split.after and, when needed, second.split.before and second.split.after.

Details

For each distinct full name, WFO.prepare() successively squishes white space, removes sub.pattern sections, reduces names with numbers to their first word, and then keeps the first two words, plus an infraspecific rank from trinomial and the word after it. The remaining words form the authorship. A second set of brackets in the authorship (as in "(Benth.) Brenan (1950)") and everything after it is removed.

Flag columns are character columns, as in WorldFlora: "TRUE" or "" for punctuation and pointless; the number of characters, and the short word itself, for genus.nchar, genus.2, species.nchar and species.2.

Each distinct name is processed once, so messages and warnings are given once per distinct name.

See also

WFO.match(), which accepts the prepared names, with Authorship used to calculate Auth.dist.

Examples

x <- c(
  "Acacia nilotica subsp. kraussiana (Benth.) Brenan",
  "Ficus sycomorus L.", "Prunus africana (Hook. f.) Kalkman",
  "Coffea sp. 3"
)
WFO.prepare(x, verbose = FALSE)
#>                                           spec.full
#> 1 Acacia nilotica subsp. kraussiana (Benth.) Brenan
#> 2                                Ficus sycomorus L.
#> 3                Prunus africana (Hook. f.) Kalkman
#> 4                                      Coffea sp. 3
#>                           spec.name         Authorship genus.nchar genus.2
#> 1 Acacia nilotica subsp. kraussiana    (Benth.) Brenan           6        
#> 2                   Ficus sycomorus                 L.           5        
#> 3                   Prunus africana (Hook. f.) Kalkman           6        
#> 4                            Coffea                              6        
#>   species.nchar species.2 punctuation pointless
#> 1             8                                
#> 2             9                                
#> 3             8                                
#> 4                                              

WFO.preprepare(c(
  "Acacia nilotica subsp. kraussiana var. major L.",
  "Ficus sycomorus L."
))
#>                                         spec.full first       split.before
#> 1 Acacia nilotica subsp. kraussiana var. major L.  TRUE    Acacia nilotica
#> 2                              Ficus sycomorus L. FALSE Ficus sycomorus L.
#>                       split.after only.second also.second second.split.before
#> 1 subsp. kraussiana var. major L.       FALSE        TRUE   subsp. kraussiana
#> 2                            <NA>       FALSE       FALSE                    
#>   second.split.after
#> 1      var. major L.
#> 2
